_doc: Focused suites iterate one style in depth; breadth runs one case per style; a batch suite verifies one release's batch of changes: its gate cases run first and alone, and the rest run only if the gate passed (SPEC: E2E suites, Batch changes, then verify the batch).

covers.hello: cheap gate: new interfaces end to end (Improve completion, knowledge follow-up return, the driver)
covers.seat-reservations: stateful style; concurrency with the web chain (no shared /tmp names)
covers.battleship-scoring: follow-on: retention of spec, environment and architecture across runs
